data.explanation: This is a private doctor's bill (Privatärztliche Liquidation), not a statutory health insurance claim. Pay the amount shown by the deadline shown, quoting the invoice number as the payment reference. You can submit this invoice to your private health insurance for reimbursement. If you dispute any item on the bill, contact the practice directly; no legal appeal procedure applies to a private invoice.
